Class Context

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.canvas.Context
public class Context extends Object
The drawing context for a Canvas.

Maintains the painting state during canvas operations, including the grid of points, text labels, and layer management.

Applications typically don't create Context instances directly. Instead, the Canvas widget creates and passes a Context to the paint callback.
